# Fixed hydration experiment inputs

cases.json identifies matching external database/helper/source inputs for the
opt-in descriptor-hydration experiment. Only hashes and small callsites are
included; generated proprietary code and captures are not checked in. The
inventory is not a generic product allowlist, and changing hashes does not
qualify new payloads. Expected descriptor fields stay private to the harness.
See [helper boundaries](../../../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md#optional-nsight-helpers).
